root_cause.text: The `idxd_conf_device_release()` function in the `idxd` driver fails to destroy the workqueue (`idxd->wq`) associated with the `idxd_device` when the device object is released, leading to a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq)` was added to `idxd_conf_device_release()` in `drivers/dma/idxd/sysfs.c` to ensure the workqueue is properly cleaned up when the configuration device is freed.
